item.title: Did GTA 6 really recreate Charlie Kirk's assassination?
item.description: Just days after its release, Grand Theft Auto 6 has become a vehicle for political misinformation. Viral footage falsely claims the game features a mission recreating Charlie Kirk’s assassination, while pro-Russian accounts are sharing fake screenshots containing anti-Ukrainian messages. Meanwhile, Russia’s own Defence Ministry has exploited the game's popularity to promote military recruitment. Vedika Bahl explains how GTA 6 is being used to push real political agendas in Truth or Fake. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Wisconsin railway tunnel reopens after seven years, recalling a remarkable 1887 construction feat
item.description: The Stewart Tunnel in Wisconsin has officially reopened for cyclists after an extensive restoration initiative. It was closed in 2019 due to safety hazards associated with falling rocks, prompting significant renovation work. Originally constructed in 1886 for the Illinois Central Railroad, the tunnel historically facilitated passenger and freight transport until the 1970s. The restoration included adding a metal liner and drainage to enhance safety while maintaining its historic character. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Michigan widow's $78m truck crash award cut by $24m as court orders retrial on $19m claim
item.description: A Michigan appeals court overturned a $24 million award for pre-impact fright in a wrongful death case. The court ruled that state law does not allow compensation for fear experienced before injury. A new trial has been ordered for the $19 million awarded for conscious pain and suffering. The trial originally awarded over $78 million for the negligence of an 18-wheel lorry driver. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Poland says will create no-fly zone at Ukraine border after repeated airspace violations
item.description: Poland will soon create a no-fly zone near the Ukrainian border, a deputy defence minister announced on Wednesday, after several incursions into its airspace it blamed on Russia. Poland backs Ukraine as it fights off Russia's near five-year invasion and has repeatedly accused Moscow of seeking to target Kyiv's supporters with drone incursions and other methods. The no-fly zone is intended to allow Polish forces to quickly identify any Russian military aircraft and shoot them down if necessary. FRANCE 24's Selina Sykes reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Este 25 de noviembre se conmemora el Día Internacional de la Eliminación de la Violencia contra las Mujeres. Año tras año, las agresiones y los asesinatos contra las mujeres en el mundo no disminuyen, sino que aumentan. Según datos publicados por la Oficina de las Naciones Unidas contra la Droga y el Delito (UNODC) y ONU Mujeres, 47.000 mujeres y niñas fueron asesinadas intencionalmente durante 2025 por su pareja o algún integrante de su familia. Mientras tanto, el hogar sigue siendo el lugar más peligroso para una mujer o una niña. Hablamos sobre avances y retos en #InvitadoDelDíaF24 con… Fuente: France 24 - Español.
